query: Run /blueprint create for a mature subscription platform. We need a durable architecture constitution, but we cannot pause feature delivery or rewrite the system. Use the repository as evidence and show a safe evolution path.
expected_behavior: Inspects the repository and operational evidence before defining the target architecture
Separates observed current state, approved target state, and the next safe transition
Defines stable principles, quality attributes, boundaries, ownership, dependency rules, state transitions, side effects, failure recovery, trust zones, observability, and verification expectations
Writes the normative constitution and descriptive current-system record into .resonance/04_systems.md instead of embedding project architecture in the reusable skill
Keeps principles and constraints distinct from technology and deployment facts, and makes a technology binding only through a stable normative rule
Uses linked ADRs, diagrams, inventories, and runbooks only as non-normative annexes instead of creating a parallel authority
Proposes bounded migration seams that preserve working behavior instead of recommending a total rewrite
Labels evidence, assumptions, decisions, and unresolved questions distinctly
Requires human approval before the blueprint becomes the conformance baseline
